'''2003 Spain National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held at La Ronda in Barcelona on 14 June 2003.<ref name="pc-intl03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040621085705/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> [[Ignasi Fandos]] was the tournament director.<ref name="pc-intl03" />

The [[Players Committee]]'s 2003 State, Provincial and National Championships were the Level 1 events of its 2003 Championship Circuit; each awarded a bye into the [[2003 World Championship|World Championships]].<ref name="pc-champ0206">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Barcelona, Spain
* '''Dates:''' 14 June 2003<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Venue:''' La Ronda, Barcelona<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Time:''' 10am<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Fee:''' 5 euros<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Ignasi Fandos]]<ref name="pc-intl03" />
